Although Agent Pelotinia was successfully clocked in via Kasocius, no prior notification or permission request was sent to any group chat, TL, or Assistant Manager (AM).

Upon investigation, the following sequence of events was noted:

11:15 PM PST: The system detected that the agent logged out without prior notice. While the agent claimed he was merely on a break, schedule checks verified this was not a scheduled break period.

12:14 AM PST: The agent logged out once again without obtaining approval from any TL or support personnel.

1:12 AM PST: As of this time, the agent has still not been detected logging back in or returning to take calls.

This prolonged unauthorized absence directly impacted operational utilization (OU) and resulted in lost productive hours for the campaign.

POLICY VIOLATION

This action falls under the Code of Conduct / Code of Discipline – Group 2: Performance of Duties:

Provision 2.14: "Abandoning work while logged IN or attempting to be paid while not at work. This also includes logging in to the timekeeper and leaving work area without permission."
Employee Explanation:
I am writing this response to formally share my side of the story regarding the Notice to Explain issued to me concerning allegations of Abandonment of Post. I appreciate this opportunity to provide full context and clarify the timeline of events that transpired.

1. Timeline of Events & Context

11:15 PM – Restroom Break:
I briefly stepped away from my station at 11:15 PM for a quick restroom break.

10:30 PM Scheduled Break & Delayed Break Utilization at 12:25 AM:
My scheduled break was originally set for 10:30 PM, but due to floor demands/calls, I missed that slot. In line with operational directives, I logged out at 12:25 AM to utilize this missed 30-minute break.

12:55 AM – WhatsApp Notification & Pantry / Cashier Delay:
At 12:55 AM, Ms. Janille reached out to me via WhatsApp to inquire about my presence. At that moment, I was already attempting to return to the production floor. However, due to a lack of available food options in the company pantry, I had to purchase food outside/at the cafeteria area. While paying, the cashier experienced technical/system issues with payment processing. Because I had already handed over my payment card to the cashier, I could not immediately walk away and had to wait for the transaction to complete.

1:14 AM – Return to Workstation:
Despite my intent to return promptly after my 30-minute break ended at 12:55 AM, the unforeseen delay at the cashier extended my return. I successfully logged back in and set my status to active around 1:14 AM.

Description:
During the QA review of the call, Fritz Acuna was identified as having an opportunity to improve his communication and call-handling approach, particularly in terms of his tone of voice and demonstration of empathy. The QA markdown noted that his tone came across as heavy and was perceived as rude and unfriendly during portions of the interaction. Additionally, the call lacked an appropriate empathetic response when an interruption occurred.

Fritz explained that one of the challenges he encountered during the call was that the customer was having difficulty hearing him clearly. In an effort to make sure the customer could hear and understand the information being provided, Fritz adjusted his voice and increased his volume slightly. His intention was to accommodate the customer's difficulty in hearing and ensure that the communication remained clear.

However, while attempting to communicate more clearly, the interaction experienced interruptions that affected the flow of the conversation. During these instances, Fritz was not able to demonstrate sufficient empathy or acknowledgment of the customer's situation. The manner in which he communicated during the interruption, combined with the heavier tone of voice, resulted in the interaction being perceived as less warm, friendly, and customer-focused.

Fritz acknowledges that although his intention was to help the customer hear and understand him, the delivery of the message is equally important. Increasing his voice volume should still be done while maintaining a calm, professional, and friendly tone. He understands that a heavier tone can unintentionally be interpreted by the customer as rude, impatient, or unfriendly, even when that was not his intention.

He also recognizes the importance of showing empathy whenever a customer experiences an interruption, difficulty hearing, or any other inconvenience during the call. An appropriate acknowledgment or empathetic statement can help reassure the customer, maintain rapport, and prevent the interaction from escalating or becoming uncomfortable.

Fritz accepts the QA feedback and acknowledges the areas of improvement identified during the review. He understands that maintaining a professional tone, practicing active listening, avoiding unnecessary interruptions, and demonstrating empathy are essential parts of delivering a positive customer experience.

Fritz acknowledges the infraction and understands the importance of the QA feedback. He recognizes that his intention to make the customer hear him clearly does not remove the need to maintain an appropriate tone and demonstrate empathy throughout the interaction.

He commits to improving his communication approach by being more conscious of his tone, avoiding unnecessary interruptions, and responding with empathy whenever the customer experiences difficulty during the call. Fritz will use this feedback as an opportunity to improve his call-handling skills and ensure that future interactions are delivered in a clear, professional, respectful, and customer-focused manner.
Employee Explanation:
During the call, I noticed that the customer was having difficulty hearing me clearly, so I slightly increased my voice volume to make sure that the information I was providing could be understood. However, I acknowledge that my tone may have sounded heavier than I intended, especially during the interruptions in the conversation.

I understand that even though my intention was to help the customer hear me better, I should have maintained a calm, friendly, and professional tone throughout the interaction. I also recognize that I could have shown more empathy and acknowledged the customer's situation to make them feel more comfortable and understood.

I accept the QA feedback and acknowledge the areas I need to improve. Moving forward, I will be more mindful of my tone of voice, practice patience and active listening, avoid unnecessary interruptions, and show empathy whenever a customer experiences difficulty during a call. I will use this feedback as an opportunity to improve my communication skills and ensure that I provide a professional, respectful, and positive customer experience in future interactions.

During the conduct of her Global Audits, Rosal entered the total item count and provided Yes/No responses for the “Is Merged/Tailgating?” and “Is the Receipt Correct?” fields in the audit sheet without having fully reviewed or completed the audit of the corresponding sessions. Since these fields serve as indicators that a session has been reviewed, completing them prematurely created the impression that the sessions had already been audited when, in fact, they had not. As a result, the sessions were overlooked during the audit process, compromising audit accuracy and resulting in three deviations within a single Global Audit week. These deviations were subsequently identified and raised by the client during the WBR.

When asked to explain the reason behind this practice, Rosal acknowledged that it was an error on her part and admitted that she had entered the item counts and marked the Yes/No fields without fully checking the sessions. However, she was unable to provide a specific reason for doing so and clarified that she had not received any instruction to follow this practice.

It is important to note that Rosal had previously been guided on the proper procedures for conducting Global Audits and was provided with the AiFi Audit SOP upon her assignment as the account's QA. The established guidelines clearly outline the expected audit process and the importance of ensuring that all required checks are completed before recording audit results.

This incident reflects a lapse in following established audit procedures and exercising the necessary attention to detail when performing her assigned responsibilities. The premature completion of audit fields resulted in preventable audit misses and an avoidable client escalation, which could have been prevented through proper adherence to the provided guidelines and more careful validation of each session prior to marking it as complete.
Employee Explanation:
Dear Management,

Good day.

I respectfully submit this written explanation in response to the Notice to Explain regarding the identified deviations during the conduct of my Global Audits.

First and foremost, I sincerely acknowledge my oversight in prematurely entering the total item counts and marking the Yes/No fields for “Is Merged/Tailgating?” and “Is the Receipt Correct?” before fully reviewing and completing the corresponding sessions.

I understand that these fields serve as indicators that an audit has been properly conducted and completed. By completing them ahead of the actual review, I unintentionally created an inaccurate impression that the sessions had already been audited. I recognize that this was a lapse in my judgment and that it contributed to sessions being overlooked, ultimately resulting in the three deviations raised during the Global Audit week.

I would like to clarify that this was not intentional, nor was it my intention to misrepresent the audit results or disregard the established procedures. I acknowledge that I should have exercised greater care and ensured that every required verification was completed before recording any results in the audit sheet. While I cannot provide a specific justification for why I proceeded with this practice, I take full responsibility for my actions and recognize that I should have followed the prescribed audit process consistently.

I also acknowledge that I was previously provided with the AiFi Audit SOP and guidance on the proper procedures for conducting Global Audits. I understand the importance of these guidelines, particularly in maintaining audit accuracy, ensuring accountability, and upholding the quality standards expected by both the company and the client.

Moving forward, I am committed to implementing the following corrective measures to prevent a similar incident from happening again:

Complete Session Verification: I will ensure that every session is thoroughly reviewed and all required audit checks are completed before entering the final item count or marking any Yes/No fields in the audit tracker.

However, following the transition to DST, our break schedules required an additional one-hour adjustment, while Starmatic was still reflecting the previous EST schedule. I am not dismissing the reported incidents, but I genuinely believe that these cases deserve further technical and operational verification before being classified as non-compliance or potential call avoidance. I would appreciate the opportunity to review the corresponding timestamps, system logs, and individual case records so that I can better understand the findings and address any legitimate gaps, if there are any.

I would also like to emphasize that intentionally avoiding calls, dispatches, or assigned responsibilities has never been my intention. I understand that every acknowledgment and system action contributes to our overall operational performance and customer experience.

I remain open to constructive feedback, clarification, and coaching wherever necessary. However, I also hope that the assessment will be based on accurate system records and the actual circumstances surrounding each incident.

Once again, thank you for allowing me to explain my side. I value my responsibilities and remain committed to complying with our operational procedures, maintaining accountability, and continuously improving my performance.

Respectfully,
Johnron Pelotinia
